column3: BSB renders “various trials” as “trials of many kinds.”
BSB supplies “God” as subject; the Textus Receptus has “the Lord,” and the critical text has no subject.
BSB renders “having willed, He brought us forth” as “He chose to give us birth.”
BSB follows the critical text with “understand this” (Ἴστε); the Textus Receptus reads “Therefore.”
BSB renders “excess of wickedness” as “every expression of evil.”
BSB adds “to do so” and renders “a doer of the work” as “an effective doer.”
BSB follows the critical text without “among you,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB renders “visit” as “care for” and adds “our.”
